# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Currently, only the latest major release of `blockscan` is actively supported with security updates. 

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within `blockscan`, please do not open a public issue. Instead, please follow these steps:

1. Email the maintainer team or report the vulnerability directly via GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature on the repository.
2. Provide a detailed description of the vulnerability, including steps to reproduce it.
3. Include any relevant logs, configuration files, or environment details.

We take all security reports seriously and will strive to acknowledge your report within 48 hours. A patch will be developed and a security advisory will be issued once the fix is verified and merged.
